stanza: I come from wealth and beauty

stanza: One night I overheard the Prior exchanging words
With a penitent whaler from the sea
The captain of his ship, who matched you toe to tip
The following day, I shipped to sea with a privateer
And in the whistle of the wind I could almost hear...

wanton.linePrev: You took your love to the marketplace
wanton.line: In the wanton corner of a Western state
wanton.lineNext: Where every other shopper is a basket case
stanza: You took your love to the marketplace
In the wanton corner of a Western state
Where every other shopper is a basket case
Just realizing the horizon forms a frowning face
Hanging around those haunts at night
Where half the clientele was part poltergeist
Grinding an axe against all that exists
Minus their protected exceptions to it
